LESSON: WATER ITS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and
Topic 1.2: Water its resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Water its resources. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify ways of storing water in the home and school
2. store water appropriately in the home and school
3. appreciate safe water storage to prevent health risks to self and others. appropriate ways of storing water at home and school on ways of storing water in the at home and report back 84

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify ways of storing water in the home and school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify ways of storing water in the home and school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. store water appropriately in the home and school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to store water appropriately in the home and school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate safe water storage to prevent health risks to self and others. appropriate ways of storing water at home and school on ways of storing water in the at home and report back 84

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Water its resources.
2. Explain Water its resources to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: In groups, learners to share their home and school experiences on how water is stored d) appreciate safe water storage at homes and school. to prevent health risks to self
4. Show that you can: identify ways of storing water in the home and school
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Water its resources. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Water its resources important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, learners to share their home and school experiences on how water is stored d) appreciate safe water storage at homes and school. to prevent health risks to self
2. Use video clips, pictures and others. and photographs to identify appropriate ways of storing water at home and school
3. Gather more information on ways of storing water in the at home and report back 84

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify ways of storing water in the home and school
2. store water appropriately in the home and school
3. appreciate safe water storage to prevent health risks to self and others. appropriate ways of storing water at home and school on ways of storing water in the at home and report back 84
